evd_title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet found no problem in 64.9% of test papers and achieved only 11.0% hit rate as a PDF-based scientific quality checker
finding: Claude 3.7 Sonnet found no problem in 64.9% of test papers and achieved only 11.0% hit rate as a PDF-based scientific quality checker
P: 245 withdrawn arXiv papers with author-stated critical errors (WithdrarXiv-Check test set; Math 52%, Physics 29%, CS 15%)
I: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (20250219), extended thinking, zero-shot fixed prompt, up to 5 problems; PDF attachment (also LaTeX)
C: Same model with LaTeX input; hits judged by Gemini 2.5 Pro + o3 (both must affirm)
O: HR@5 16.3% (PDF) vs 33.1% (LaTeX); no problem found in 64.9% of papers (PDF); avg 1.6 problems; $0.159/paper
T: Claude 3.7 Sonnet 20250219; judges Gemini 2.5 Pro preview-05-06, o3 2025-04-16; paper 2025
